actions.create_meeting_event.description: Schedule a Zoom, Teams or Meet meeting for Leexi to record.
actions.create_meeting_event.props.inter: Whether the meeting is internal (no external customers).
actions.create_meeting_event.props.meeti: Zoom, Microsoft Teams or Google Meet link.
actions.create_meeting_event.props.organ: Email address of the meeting organizer.
actions.create_meeting_event.props.owned: Whether the user is the owner of the meeting.
actions.create_meeting_event.props.title: Title
actions.create_meeting_event.props.to_re: Whether the Leexi assistant should record this meeting.
actions.create_meeting_event.props.user_: Leexi user the meeting belongs to. Get it from List Users.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).

actions.fetch_call_details.props.include: Extra sections to return. Limits the request to 5 calls.
actions.fetch_call_transcript.descriptio: Get the timestamped, speaker-labelled transcript of a Leexi call.
actions.fetch_call_transcript.props.call: UUID of the call. Get it from Query Calls.
actions.get-call.props.callId.descriptio: The UUID of the Leexi call.
actions.list_call_notes.description: List the AI notes written for a Leexi call.
UUID of the call. Get it from Query Calls.
actions.list_call_notes.props.items.desc: Number of notes per page, 1-100. Defaults to 100.
actions.list_call_notes.props.page.descr: Page number, from 1. Stop at pagination.pages.
actions.list_call_notes.props.prompt_uui: Only return the note of this prompt.
actions.list_meeting_events.description: List scheduled Leexi meeting events (calendar, manual or API).
actions.list_meeting_events.props.date_f: Which event date From/To apply to. Defaults to start_time.
actions.list_meeting_events.props.from.d: Only events on or after this time (see Date Filter).
Number of events per page, 1-100. Defaults to 20.
Sort order. Defaults to latest start time first.
actions.list_meeting_events.props.origin: Only return events from this origin.
actions.list_meeting_events.props.to.des: Only events on or before this time (see Date Filter).
actions.list_users.description: List the users of the Leexi workspace.
actions.list_users.props.items.descripti: Number of users per page, 1-100. Defaults to 100.
actions.query_calls.description: Search Leexi calls by date, people, customer or conversation type.
actions.query_calls.props.conversation_t: Only calls of this type (conversation_type.uuid on a call).
actions.query_calls.props.customer_email: Email addresses of external customers on the call.
actions.query_calls.props.customer_phone: Customer phone numbers on the call, in international format.
actions.query_calls.props.date_filter.de: Which call date From/To apply to. Defaults to created_at.
actions.query_calls.props.from.descripti: Only calls on or after this time (see Date Filter).
actions.query_calls.props.items.descript: Number of calls per page, 1-100. Defaults to 20.
actions.query_calls.props.order.descript: Sort order. Defaults to newest created first.
actions.query_calls.props.owner_uuids.de: Leexi user UUIDs that own the call. Get them from List Users.
actions.query_calls.props.page.descripti: Page number, from 1. Stop at pagination.pages.

actions.query_calls.props.source.descrip: Only return calls from this source (e.g. aircall, zoom, google_meet).
actions.query_calls.props.to.description: Only calls on or before this time (see Date Filter).
auth.description:
You can obtain Key ID and secret from [API Keys Settings](https://app.leexi.ai/en/settings/api_keys).

The key needs the scopes of the actions you use: read_calls for calls, notes, transcripts and the New Call Created trigger, read_users for List Users, read_meeting_events for List Meeting Events and write_meeting_events for Create Meeting Event. The connection check needs read_calls.
triggers.new-call-created.description: Triggers when a new call is created.
